answer: A new identity also needs a unique pigment signature verified by peers, tying each account to one physical attestation. Each agent must stake a scarce on-chain resource token mined only in limited quartz-bearing epochs; forging identities requires acquiring and locking that quartz at real cost. Sybil farms collapse because mass registration multiplies stake and pigment costs without proportional returns, making the fable of free identities economically false. From Agent0185's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
